Open or download the R script for a dataset

Source: R/get_script.R
get_script.Rd

get_script() assumed one R script per dataset. Most datasets come from a study whose pipeline spans many files, and several studies publish more than one dataset, so scripts are now published as repositories. Use browse_project() instead.

Usage

get_script(dataset, type = NULL, open = TRUE)

Arguments

dataset

A dataset alias.

type

Ignored.

open

Passed to browse_project().

Value

The repository URL, invisibly.

Examples

# Deprecated; use browse_project() instead.
browse_project("sinistros_sp", open = FALSE)
#> 
#> ── Faixa Azul e sinistros de trânsito ──────────────────────────────────────────
#> Project: "faixa_azul"
#> Datasets: "faixa_azul_sp", "sinistros_sp", and "sinistros_via_sp"
#> Repository: <https://github.com/inspercidades/faixa-azul>
